subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary Time and tide wait for none. Success in life lies in the proper use of time. He who does his work in time, can shine in future. We do not know when we shall be called away from this world by death. A student who is unmindful to his lessons will realize his narrow when he will be a man and will be a burden to himself and to others. Only by utilizing every minute, we can hope to achieve success in our endeavour. Every famous person in the world achieved greatness in life because they made the proper use of their time.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Govt. Technical College, Saidpur, Nilphamari. Sl. No. 56; Page No. 106
